question: Can one of the three assessed routes support a usable, meaningfully independent or unobserved comparison beyond the retrospective publication-study result?

routes.target: Previously observed official Lean, Lean4Lean, Nanoda and Kiota cases; particularly theorem/let controls and M6/M7 folds
reasons: All four families have known exact outcomes; the obvious theorem/let constructions and held-out mutant results have already been revealed.
Different authorship does not establish semantic authority. No separately selected new unobserved cell or outcome-access manifest is supplied.
missing_prerequisites: A concrete fresh cell/family selected independently of desired outcomes, with curator provenance and prior-exposure audit.
Exact input/target hashes, interpretation contract, outcome custody and preregistration before access.

reasons: The exact CLI contains only a placeholder print; a functioning checker path and compatible target are not established.
Documentation retains conflicting readiness/verification statements. A new name or Rust implementation is insufficient evidence.
missing_prerequisites: A concrete functioning checking entrypoint, versioned input contract and attributable baseline evidence from its provider.
Separate lineage, target-correspondence and outcome-access review; no implementation build is authorized by this assessment.

routes.target: Lean4Less 5b66bbc4af5c2c11313fcfb5098630dadaf19281 as a supposed extra independent checker
reasons: The framework derives from Lean4Lean and translates objects into a smaller theory. Counting it as another independent observer of unchanged bytes would confound translation with validation.
missing_prerequisites: A separately scoped translation-preservation question with explicit assumptions and target correspondence.
An independent output-checking target and frozen comparison; these are outside this item.

scope_limit: The first route covers the existing known-case pool, not every possible future cell on those checkers. No new scientific cell or case was constructed.
nonclaims: No new normative source, catalog disposition, checker outcome or defect.
No independence by checker count or LLM consensus.
Prior M6/M7 scoped transfer evidence remains valid under its original feedback boundary.
